what: Release Step 7 resolves installed metadata before the active cache-shaped CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed order can pass the already-updated metadata root to upgrade-larch while the current Claude process still runs an older cache root; prune only protects target_version and INSTALLED_VERSION derived from PLUGIN_ROOT, so the live old root can be removed during same-session recovery or rerun
suggested_fix: Prefer a valid cache-shaped CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT over installed metadata for the CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT passed to the working-tree upgrade script, or explicitly protect both the active env root version and the parsed installed version when they differ
